Looking at the error, the recursive call `Prove(s[1..])` requires `K.Clean(s[1..])` but this hasn't been established. 

The lemma `O.TailInvariant` provides exactly what we need: when `K.Clean(s)` and `2 <= |s|`, it ensures `K.Clean(s[1..])`.

Let me trace through the proof logic:
1. When `|s| < 2`, use `O.Base(s)` to show `K.Compress(s) == s`
2. When `|s| >= 2`:
   - Use `O.TailInvariant(s)` to establish `K.Clean(s[1..])` (precondition for recursive call)
   - Call `Prove(s[1..])` recursively to get `K.Compress(s[1..]) == s[1..]`
   - Use `O.Boundary(s)` to establish `s[0] != s[1]` (precondition for `O.Keep`)
   - Use `O.Keep(s)` to get `K.Compress(s) == [s[0]] + K.Compress(s[1..])`
   - Since `K.Compress(s[1..]) == s[1..]`, we have `K.Compress(s) == [s[0]] + s[1..] == s`

```json
{
  "HelperA.dfy": "if |s| < 2 {\n      O.Base(s);\n    } else {\n      O.TailInvariant(s);\n      Prove(s[1..]);\n      O.Boundary(s);\n      O.Keep(s);\n      assert s == [s[0]] + s[1..];\n    }"
}
```
